methods.label: Restrict the four-digit number
methods.explanation:
The change from three digits to four digits puts \(x+32\) in a very short interval. Because \(x\le 999\) and \(x+32\) has four digits,
\[
1000\le x+32\le 999+32=1031.
\]
Every number in this interval begins with the digits \(10\). A palindrome beginning with \(10\) must end with \(01\), so the only possibility is \(1001\).

Thus \(x=1001-32=969\), which is indeed a three-digit palindrome. Its digit sum is
\[
9+6+9=24.
\]
The answer is \(24\), choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
